description: A grand romantic bedroom with elaborate plaster molding and symmetrical furnishings photographed in a centered, standing-height view. Accent pillows in terracotta velvet, a floral jacquard, and a muted teal-grey linen add a warm jewel-tone layer. Flanking the bed are two matching medium-cherry traditional nightstands with curved legs, each with a single carved drawer. The left nightstand holds a tall dark ceramic vase with a spray of dried autumn branches; the right holds two small stacked books and a small lidded jar. Three gold-framed oval and rectangular oil paintings in muted pastoral tones are hung on the plaster-molded wall — one centered above the headboard, one on each side. The floor is warm honey-toned hardwood. The overall palette is warm white, honey-wood, terracotta, and rich brown, with a romantic and slightly maximalist elegance.
